intents.text: Add Response.apply_conditions(request, *, exists=True) in wrappers/response.py that evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods, treats a star ETag according to `exists`, raises PreconditionFailed on failure, turns satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD into 304 with entity headers removed, and sets Accept-Ranges: bytes.

Add Response.apply_range(request) that always sets Accept-Ranges: bytes, applies Range only for GET with a 200 response and known non-zero Content-Length (otherwise leaves the response unchanged), supports only bytes, clamps too-large stop/suffix, uses only the first range, raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, returns 206 with sliced data and Content-Range, and honors If-Range.
Add IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) -> bool in datastructures/range.py, true for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified, and use it in apply_range.

Keep Response.make_conditional working but deprecated with DeprecationWarning, implemented via apply_conditions and apply_range, and deprecate werkzeug.http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid the same way.

Make Range.from_header, Range.make_content_range and ContentRange.from_header validate their own values; make_content_range clamps too-large stop/suffix and uses the first range when several are given; ETagSet.from_header discards invalid unquoted values.

Refactor send_file in utils.py to use the new methods, detect name/size/mtime from file-like objects when possible, call seek(0) on file-like objects, drop the path hash from the ETag, and default to application/octet-stream when download_name is not passed instead of raising.
Make SharedDataMiddleware serve files through send_file, stop setting cache_timeout by default, and deprecate (still accept, with DeprecationWarning) its cache and fallback_mimetype parameters.
Document the new methods in the quickstart docs and add a changelog entry.

Add tests for apply_conditions (each header, method coverage, star ETag with/without resource, 304 vs 412) and apply_range (first range only, clamping, unsatisfiable, 206 with correct Content-Range); update send_file tests for detection, seek, ETag and mimetype behaviour; move or remove tests of the deprecated functions; suite must pass with pytest -m "not dev_server".

constraints: Leave everything not listed in the request unchanged
make_conditional, is_resource_modified, is_byte_range_valid, and SharedDataMiddleware cache/fallback_mimetype must still be accepted/working, only deprecated
Test suite must stay green with pytest -m "not dev_server"
